heard: Our solar system is drifting through a massive hollow cavity. Roughly 15 ancient supernovas blasted this hole a thousand light years wide. This void is filled with plasma heated to a million degrees. Deep sea crust on Earth still holds radioactive iron from those explosions. The shockwaves triggered the birth of every star within 500 light years. Newborn nurseries like the Taurus Cloud sit on the bubble's expanding edge. Surprisingly, our sun didn't carve this void, we just drifted into it recently, leaving us passing directly through a massive hollow cavity.
